manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the blue pen on the box and insert it into the pen holder on the right.

Task description: The target is the blue pen lying on the white box. The target holder is the white square pen holder on the right, which already contains a black pen.

Success criteria: One end of the blue pen passes through the right-side pen holder opening, and the barrel is inserted and remains inside. Merely hovering above or resting across the rim does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Try to grip a straight section of the pen barrel near its clip end, away from the clip protrusion. Leave enough length at the other end for insertion, and close across the barrel.
- The gripper opening can be slightly wider than the pen shaft. Near the box surface, confirm that the fingers are on opposite sides of the shaft and the pads can make effective contact, avoiding pushing the pen so it rolls away with one finger.
- During transport or pose adjustment, leave room for both ends of the pen to turn, avoiding the box surface, sign behind the pen holder, and tall divider to reduce contact with them.
- Insert with the exposed pen end downward, targeting free space inside the holder away from the black pen while keeping the gripper above the rim. If the tip hits the rim, lift slightly and adjust rather than pressing down and toppling the holder.
- Before releasing, confirm that the pen is inside the holder and supported. Open and withdraw slowly to avoid it falling out if inserted too shallowly or being lifted by the pads.

narration: I will use the piper-control skill to execute this authorized physical-robot episode strictly with the given parameters, operating from the returned manual and live observations.

I have read the returned manual and confirmed only the right arm is available. The blue pen still lies on the white box. I am adjusting approach direction at height, then will align to its shaft in small steps and confirm the grasp.

An orientation adjustment hit the controller's position limit; the returned state shows the arm moved only partway. I adjusted the path using the latest measured position and will continue the approach within this episode. The pen has not yet been contacted or grasped.
The gripper is above the pen shaft, and I am adjusting its direction to cross the shaft. Next I will align in steps no greater than 1 cm and check the positions of both fingers before closing.

The first small test lift did not confirm that the pen was grasped, and its position on the box did not visibly change. I opened the gripper and will lower the approach height further before checking again.

After closing this time, the measured opening stopped at about 18 mm, with signs of contact. I will first make a small test lift and check whether the blue pen rises with the gripper before deciding whether to carry it.

After the test lift, the gripper was almost fully closed, indicating the pen had not been held securely. I moved to another flat area around the middle of the shaft and realigned both pads; the pen is still on the box surface.

The blue pen rose with the gripper, and its measured opening stayed at about 15.7 mm; current observations support that it is securely grasped. I will lift gradually and adjust the pen's pose, then move it toward the pen holder on the right.

The grasp stayed stable during lifting and sideways movement, and the blue pen is off the box surface. I am now moving toward the front of the pen holder, leaving clearance from the black pen inside and the sign behind it.

The pen is above the holder with its tail facing downward and still some distance from the opening. I will maintain the current tilt, align with the gap to the left of the black pen, and complete insertion in small lowering steps.

The blue pen's lower end has entered the holder opening's projected area; neither holder nor black pen moved noticeably. I am deepening insertion slightly, then will release and retreat to check whether the blue pen stays inside.

After release, the blue pen fell into the holder and stayed inside during gripper withdrawal, leaning beside the black pen. Next I will move the gripper farther away, obtain an unobstructed final observation, and end this episode.
